$comment: Every score mcp-observatory emits, declared against contracts/score_envelope.json (vendored from ContextWeave). tests/test_score_contract.py holds this file to the contract and resolves every producer.

scores.name: observatory.composite_risk_score
scores.evidence: signals_defined: how many of the risk indicators could be computed
scores.meaning: Weighted mean of lexical risk indicators over the defined set, renormalised. Not a probability of harm; comparable only at equal signals_defined. Null when no indicator is defined.

scores.name: observatory.hallucination_risk_score
scores.meaning: Weighted blend of grounding, self-consistency, verifier, numeric variance and tool-claim mismatch; hand-set weights, never compared with an outcome.

scores.name: observatory.grounding_score
scores.meaning: Lexical overlap between an answer and the retrieved context. Null without context.

scores.name: observatory.self_consistency_score
scores.meaning: Agreement between two generations of the same answer. Null without a second generation.

scores.name: observatory.proposal_composite_score
scores.evidence: number of defined signals in the proposal
scores.meaning: Weighted composite of a proposed tool call's risk signals in the propose/commit flow.
